questions.text: What does PCT stand for in the PCT Parent Process?
questions.explanation: PCT stands for Production Control Team. The PCT Parent Process manages house/farm preparation before birds arrive.

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of the PCT Parent Process?
options: Manage house and farm preparation before a new flock arrives
Record daily QM data for laying farms
Create sales orders for spent hens
questions.explanation: The PCT Parent Process (House Preparation) manages all activities needed to prepare a farm house or facility before birds are placed — from checking the preparation plan to confirming house preparation via GR.

questions.text: Who is responsible for recording daily QM data using SAP Fiori in Parent Rearing?
questions.explanation: The Parent Rearing Responsible records daily QM data using SAP Fiori. The PHD Responsible separately confirms vaccine activities.

questions.text: In the Parent Rearing process, which actions are labeled 'One Time Action'?
options: Create Production Orders, Update Order Data, Order Approval
questions.explanation: Creating the Production Order, Updating Order Data, and Order Approval are all 'One Time Actions' — performed once per flock when the batch starts. Daily QM and Activity Confirmations repeat every day.

questions.text: In the Parent Laying process, what happens when the Sales Plan check says YES?
options: Spent hens are sent to Processing Plant
Spent hens are issued against a Sales Order for external sale
Spent hens are returned to rearing farms
A new production order is created for the next flock
questions.explanation: When the 'Check Sales Plan' decision is YES, the spent hens (Pullets 64WK) are issued to a Sales Order for external sale. When NO, they are issued to Processing.

questions.text: What is the sequence of steps to prepare a house under the PCT Parent Process?
options: Check Preparation Plan → Create PO → Approve PO → GR House
Check Preparation Plan → Create Production Order → Order Approval → Activity Confirmation → House Prepared GR → Issue to Order → DLV & TECO
Create Production Order → Release → CO11N → TECO
Check Placement Plan → GR DOC → CO11N → TECO
questions.explanation: The full PCT house preparation sequence is: Check Preparation Plan → Create Production Order (House Prep) → Order Approval → Activity Confirmation → House Prepared GR → Issue to Parent Rearing/Laying Order → Production Order DLV & TECO.

questions.text: How many swim-lane diagrams are covered in this document?
questions.explanation: Three swim-lane diagrams are covered: (1) PCT Parent Process, (2) Parent Rearing Process, and (3) Parent Process Pre-Laying & Laying.

questions.text: Who is responsible for issuing Day-Old Chicks to the Parent Rearing farm?
questions.explanation: The GP-Hatchery Responsible issues Day-Old Chicks to the parent rearing farm, while Parent Rearing creates the DOC Purchase Order and confirms receipt.

questions.text: In Parent Pre-Laying, what two inputs does the Pre-Laying order consume?
questions.explanation: The Pre-Laying production order issues two items: House Preparation (from the PCT process) and Pullets 19WK (from the Rearing farm). Both are consumed to start the 24WK pre-laying phase.
